title: Cruise Tahoe

services.name: Cruise Tahoe
services.desc: Includes: Cruise to to North America’s Premier Wooden Boat Show - The Lake Tahoe Concours D’Elegance. Admission to show included!Time: Friday, August 7, 2026: 10:00am - 4:00pm - Saturday, August 8, 2026: 12:00pm - 6:00pmLocation: Leaving from Tahoe Keys Marina, 2435 Venice Drive East, South Lake Tahoe, CA 96150 For classic boat lovers, this is one of the most fitting ways to experience one of Lake Tahoe’s most celebrated boating events. Cruise Tahoe’s Concours D’Elegance charter takes guests aboard The Tahoe, a classic wooden boat, for transportation to and from the renowned wooden boat show. Guests have time to deboard, attend the show, and view the incredible collection of classic boats

services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Turn your Lake Tahoe boat day into an adventure with a private watersports boat charter built for fun, flexibility, and time on the water. Enjoy a mix of scenic cruising, swimming, tubing, wakeboarding, or wakesurfing, with plenty of room to customize the experience around your group. Whether you want a high-energy day behind the boat or a relaxed cruise with a few active moments mixed in, this is a great option for guests who want more than a traditional sightseeing
